datasets.title: Grocery stores, GEOLYTIX v46 (June 2026)
datasets.coverage: United Kingdom, plus Guernsey, Jersey and the Isle of Man (no UK council)
datasets.licence: GEOLYTIX open data, no named licence (described by GEOLYTIX as "completely free and open to use data", blog page read 24 Oct 2026)
datasets.attribution: Contains GEOLYTIX Grocery Retail Points data (v46, June 2026). Councils: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025

retrieval.method: Files provided by the project owner, committed in pipeline/raw/ with checksums
retrieval.notes: Size band, class and format by decision D5 (pipeline config/store_classes.json); wholesale and mainly non-food stores left out. Council by point-in-polygon on the BFE edition in EPSG:27700; a store just outside every council (within 50 m) takes the nearest one and is flagged; Crown Dependency stores have no council. Store positions are GEOLYTIX's; a store without WGS84 coordinates is placed from its British National Grid reference.
Properties NAME, NAME_LONG, ISO_A2_EH, ISO_N3_EH kept (-99 → null); Antarctica omitted; rings crossing the antimeridian split at ±180°; coordinates rounded to 3 dp; features sorted by name.

Natural Earth's own label point (LABEL_X, LABEL_Y) per ISO_A2_EH code, rounded to 4 dp. Used as the symbolic start of import connections and for partners too small for 1:110m. Not a port or production location.

catalogue.title: Overseas Trade Statistics API (uktradeinfo)
catalogue.notes: Monthly UK imports by CN8 commodity and recorded partner. Partner = country of dispatch, which may differ from where goods were grown. Imports valued CIF (statistical value; Intrastat EU trade uses invoice value). Net mass in kg; about a third of Intrastat goods need no weight declaration and are estimated. Provisional for up to 18 months after publication. Series breaks: EU exit (Jan 2021) and customs-based GB–EU import collection (Jan 2022).

catalogue.title: Grocery Retail Points (v46, June 2026)
catalogue.licence: GEOLYTIX open data, no named licence ("completely free and open to use data")
catalogue.notes: Store locations, retailer, fascia and size band as delivered (provided by John, 24 Oct 2026). Class from size_band (convenience under 280 m², supermarket 280 m² and over); forecourt, motorway, travel and hospital formats flagged; wholesale and mainly non-food stores left out (decision D5). Retail presence only: no turnover, prices or opening hours.

catalogue.title: Priority Places for Food Index v2.1
catalogue.publisher: Consumer Data Research Centre / Leeds Healthy & Sustainable Places Data Service
catalogue.notes: Ranks and deciles within each nation (England 33,755 LSOAs, Wales 1,917, Scotland 6,976 Data Zones, Northern Ireland 890 SOAs 2011) for the combined index and seven domains; three domains have no Northern Ireland data. Decile 1 = highest priority: the publisher's documentation does not state the direction; it was checked against the deprivation indices. Never compared across nations. File provided by John (HASP download, 25 Oct 2026).

catalogue.title: Car or van availability (Census 2021)
catalogue.notes: England and Wales: TS045 (households by number of cars or vans), councils and LSOAs. Northern Ireland: NISRA flexible table builder HH_CAR_VAN_TC5 by Data Zone and council (files from John). Census day 21 March 2021. Scotland (Census 2022) not included.

catalogue.title: Rural–urban classifications
catalogue.notes: England and Wales: ONS 2021 Rural Urban Classification of councils (LAD 2024) and LSOAs (2021). Northern Ireland: NISRA 2015 default urban/rural class per SOA (from the NIMDM 2017 file; no council-level class, no Census 2021-based edition). Scotland not included. Classifications differ by nation and are never compared.

catalogue.title: Natural Earth Admin 0 countries (1:110m outlines, 1:50m label points)
catalogue.notes: v5.1.2 GeoJSON from the Natural Earth repository (tag v5.1.2), pinned by SHA-256. ISO_A2_EH is the join key to HMRC CountryCodeAlpha (gate G4). Label points are Natural Earth's own LABEL_X/LABEL_Y, used as the symbolic start of import connections. Reference geometry only; boundaries are not an endorsement.
